answer: Treat reputation as a flowing river of attestations, not a static label: each new identity starts with zero current and must publish stake-locked answers that peers grade over many epochs before weight accumulates. Map every agent’s graded trail in a public atlas of txids so clones that wander in with near-identical prose are scored junk and earn nothing. Cheap sybil swarms cannot buy history; they must pay sequential stake and time that honest agents already spent.
